anchor: The inter-pool handoff is priced single-stream (~1.6 MB per image); Qwen3-VL's DeepStack projections quadruple that payload, and a sensitivity replay of the aggregate at the 4x payload on the modeled 25 Gbps link raises p99 handoff from 272 to 1,087 ms (encoder-delay p99 1,404 ms --- an SLA violation from transfer alone).
claim_text: Handoff: single-stream ~1.6MB/image; 4x payload on 25Gbps raises p99 handoff 272->1,087ms, encoder p99 1,404ms (SLA violation).

adjudication.observed: Baseline 25 Gbps (aggregate44:fc_p90_L30): handoff p99 272.001 ms, encoder-delay p99 588.37 ms. Sensitivity 6.25 Gbps representing 4x payload (aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4): handoff p99 1087.406 ms, encoder-delay p99 1403.774 ms, handoff_alone_violates_sla = true.
adjudication.evidence: The v_fabric_sensitivity view perfectly validates the numbers. Single-stream payload (~1.6 MB/img) is analytically derived from 196 tokens * 4096 hidden size * 2 bytes (bf16) = ~1.606 MB. A 4x payload on a 25 Gbps link is mathematically equivalent to a 1x payload on a 6.25 Gbps link by transmission linearity (explicitly documented in results-ledger.md). At 6.25 Gbps, handoff p99 rises to 1087.406 ms, and encoder delay p99 to 1403.774 ms, violating the 1,000 ms SLA from transfer alone.
adjudication.query: SELECT run_id, handoff_gbps, handoff_p99_ms, encoder_delay_p99_ms, handoff_alone_violates_sla FROM provenance.v_fabric_sensitivity WHERE run_id IN ('aggregate44:fc_p90_L30', 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4') ORDER BY handoff_gbps DESC;

adjudication.observed: Baseline encoder_delay p99=588.37 ms; ds4 encoder_delay p99=1403.774 ms; both have n_requests=749601, window_name=NULL, is_current=true, superseded_by=NULL.
adjudication.evidence: v_pool_latency supports the rounded 1,404 ms ds4 encoder-delay result, but exposes no payload size, DeepStack multiplier, link rate, handoff percentile, SLA flag, per-window breakdown, or transfer-alone causal attribution.
adjudication.fix: State only that the aggregate ds4 sensitivity raises encoder-delay p99 from 588.37 to 1403.774 ms over 749601 requests; remove the payload, 25 Gbps, 272->1,087 ms handoff, SLA, and transfer-alone assertions unless separately provenance-backed.
adjudication.query: SELECT p.run_id, p.window_name, p.sla_metric, p.p99_ms, p.n_requests, p.is_current, d.superseded_by, d.source_path FROM provenance.v_pool_latency AS p JOIN provenance.v_dim AS d USING (run_id) WHERE p.run_id IN ('aggregate44:fc_p90_L30', 'aggregate44:fc_p90_L30_ds4') AND p.is_current = true AND d.is_current = true ORDER BY p.run_id
